user.title: Sign in to Aqara Home
user.description: Use the account you sign in to the Aqara Home app with. The FP2 must be in Sleep monitoring mode.

data_description.region: The region chosen in the Aqara Home app (Profile › Settings › Region).

manual.title: Enter the FP2's ID
manual.description: No FP2 was found on this account. In the Aqara Home app open the FP2 › ⋯ › Device info and enter its ID (lumi1.…), or its MAC address.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Aqara no longer accepts the saved sign-in for {account}. Enter the Aqara Home password.

error.invalid_auth: Aqara didn't accept the account, password or region.
error.cannot_connect: No answer from Aqara. Check Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.
error.no_permission: This account has no access to that device in this region.
error.rejected: Aqara rejected the request. Check for an update to this integration.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This FP2 is already set up.

not_sleep_mode.title: {name} is not in Sleep monitoring mode
not_sleep_mode.description: The FP2 only measures heart rate, breathing and sleep stages in Sleep monitoring mode. In the Aqara Home app open the FP2 › ⋯ › Work mode and choose Sleep monitoring.
